card: This pull request disallows calling ArgsManager::IsArgSet() on options flagged with ALLOW_LIST, throwing a logic error if invoked. It prevents a class of configuration bugs where negated list arguments (like -noonlynet or -norpcwhitelist) cause IsArgSet() to return true while GetArgs() returns empty, leading callers to treat empty lists as enabled features. It eliminates call sites on list options across node startup and normalizes -noonlynet handling with Tor/I2P broadcasts. The PR is stacked on top of open PRs #16545 and #17580, with only three commits unique to this PR.
changed_since_previous: Rebased on updated base branches and adapted to new list options introduced in recent commits, specifically removing IsArgSet calls on -testactivationheight and -vbparams introduced in #35335.
evidence: PR description: 'Code that uses IsArgSet() with list options is confusing and leads to bugs when IsArgSet() returns true, but GetArgs() returns an empty list, so the option is considered enabled even though it is empty. This led to a number of bugs which are fixed in #30529'

Commit efe0fea4ec notes that specifying -noonlynet, -privatebroadcast, and -listenonion together improperly caused an init error claiming no networks are reachable because of an IsArgSet("-onlynet") check.
problem: When a list option is negated on the command line or config file (such as -norpcwhitelist or -noonlynet), IsArgSet() returns true even though GetArgs() returns an empty list. Callers checking IsArgSet() can mistakenly treat the option as active with empty parameters rather than disabled, creating subtle configuration and networking bugs.

risk.why: A missed call site or improper argument classification could throw a logic error and cause bitcoind to crash on startup under specific CLI or config combinations.

scope_notes: The PR diff includes 17 commits, but the first 14 commits are stacked from prerequisite PRs #16545 and #17580; only the final 3 commits are unique to this PR.
summary: Disallows calling ArgsManager::IsArgSet() on configuration arguments flagged with ALLOW_LIST, throwing a std::logic_error when attempted. Cleans up existing call sites across node initialization to check GetArgs().empty() or inspect settings directly instead of calling IsArgSet() on list options. Also normalizes node initialization behavior when -noonlynet is passed alongside -privatebroadcast and -listenonion.
